business_summary: Jiangxi JDL Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. provides water environmental treatment services in China. Its water pollution control equipment comprises a sewage lifting system, aeration system, membrane system, water production system, backwashing system, electrical system, shell and other standard components, and box type and tank type water pollution control equipment. The company also engages in design, material procurement, pre-processing and secondary development, on-site system integration, and commissioning, as well as providing after-sales maintenance services; environmental research and development; manufacturing, processing, and sale of environmental protection equipment; research and development, and sale of water environmental function restoration technology; production, installation, and sale of environmental protection equipment; and consulting, design, construction, unmanned, and operation management of energy conservation, engineering, and environmental protection projects. In addition, it is involved in the construction, operation, and service of water supply, sewage treatment and watershed management facilities; recycling and management of water resources; sale of water treatment equipment; water quality testing and comprehensive utilization of wastewater; and contract energy management activities. Further, the company provides leasing services, machinery and equipment leases, residual value treatment, and maintenance of leasehold property and incidental technology; and chemicals, building materials, and hardware electricity sales. Its products are used in village and town sewage treatment, municipal sewage treatment, black and odorous water treatment, industrial wastewater treatment, and other fields. The company was formerly known as Jiangxi JDL Environmental Protection Research Center Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Jiangxi JDL Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. in January 2006. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Nanchang, China.
